tasks.name: כל קפה רביעי חינם
tasks.note: Loyalty card: the price p is charged unless n (coffees already bought) is 3 mod 4, when this one is free.

tasks.name: קנה k קבל אחד חינם
tasks.note: Buy-k-get-1-free: of q items, every (k+1)-th is free; returns how many are paid (k=0 makes all free).

tasks.name: מחיר ליחידה לפי כמות
tasks.note: Volume pricing tiers: base unit price p drops by 1 from 5 items and by 2 from 10 items, never below 0.

tasks.name: אבן נייר ומספריים
tasks.note: Rock-paper-scissors on moves a%3 and b%3: 0 draw, 1 first player wins, 2 second player wins.

tasks.name: שעון 12 שעות
tasks.note: 12-hour clock display: hour h plus d hours shown as 1..12 (hour 0 or 12 displays as 12).

tasks.name: חצי מחיר עד תקרה
tasks.note: 50% off (rounded down) but the discount is capped at c: price minus min(floor(p/2), c).

tasks.name: בתוך המשמרת?
tasks.note: Wraparound time window on a 16-hour clock: flag 15 if time t lies in the len hours starting at s.

tasks.name: הקרוב ל-10
tasks.src: (a,b,c)=>{ let best=a; for(const x of [b,c]){ const d=Math.abs(x-10), bd=Math.abs(best-10); if(d<bd||(d===bd&&x>best)) best=x; } return best; }
tasks.note: Picks the input closest to a fixed target 10, breaking distance ties in favour of the larger value.

tasks.name: המחיר הנכון
tasks.src: (a,b,t)=>{ const okA=a<=t, okB=b<=t; if(okA&&okB) return a>=b?1:2; return okA?1:(okB?2:0); }
tasks.note: Price-is-right winner: the bid closest to price t without going over (1 or 2, first bidder wins ties, 0 if both over).

tasks.name: ממוצע שני הטובים
tasks.note: Score rule: drop the worst of three scores and return the floor average of the best two (sum may exceed 15).

tasks.name: חלוקת חשבון
tasks.note: Split a two-item bill a+b among n people, rounding each share up, capped at 15; n=0 gives 0.

tasks.name: פער המוביל
tasks.note: Leader's margin: the largest of three minus the second largest (0 when the top two tie).
